name: CookiePrime Schema Markup Generator
author: samirprime

sections.description:
Stop relying on bloated PHP SEO plugins that slow down your Time to First Byte (TTFB).

CookiePrime Schema Markup Generator (SchemaForge) is a next-generation structured data tool built for modern technical SEO. Using our hybrid bridge technology, it extracts pristine metadata directly from your DOM and injects pixel-perfect, Google-compliant JSON-LD schema — all without putting any extra load on your WordPress server.

Whether you run a simple blog or a complex WooCommerce store, SchemaForge ensures you capture high-converting Rich Snippets in Google Search.

🔥 Why Choose SchemaForge?

  • Zero Server Load: Schema is generated and injected without heavy PHP queries, keeping your server fast and your TTFB pristine.
  • Always Up-to-Date: Google updates their structured data requirements frequently. Our centrally managed engine ensures your schema mapping stays compliant automatically.
  • Smart Auto-Detection: Perfectly extracts data from WordPress and WooCommerce blocks without manual configuration.
  • Frictionless Compatibility: Works alongside Yoast, RankMath, and All in One SEO (just disable their schema modules to prevent duplication).

🆓 Free Features (Forever Free)

  • 6 Core Schema Types: Product, Article, FAQPage, WebPage, HowTo, and Video
  • Auto-detection from the DOM
  • Static schema validation
  • No account or email required to start

🚀 Pro Features ($29 Lifetime License)

Upgrade to Pro for advanced eCommerce and publishing sites:
* 14+ Schema Types: Recipe, JobPosting, Event, LocalBusiness, Organization, BreadcrumbList, Review, Course
* WooCommerce Pro: Advanced extraction for product variants, aggregate reviews, and real-time stock status.
* Article Pro: Automatically calculates word count, reading time, and author bios.
* JSON-LD Import & Migration: Easily transition from older schema tools.
* Competitor Schema Spy: See exactly what schemas your competitors are using to outrank you.

Get your lifetime Pro license at cookieprime.com/schemaforge.
sections.installation:
1. Log into your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “CookiePrime Schema Markup Generator”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Navigate to Settings > SchemaForge in your left-hand menu.
  6. (Optional) Enter your Organization details or paste your Pro License Key to unlock advanced schemas.
  7. You’re done! SchemaForge will automatically detect your page types and inject the correct JSON-LD.
sections.faq:
Does Google execute JavaScript to read injected schema?

Yes. Googlebot officially executes JavaScript as part of its Web Rendering Service (WRS). It reliably reads, validates, and indexes JSON-LD that is dynamically injected into the DOM via client-side scripts.

Will this conflict with my existing SEO plugin?

SchemaForge plays nicely with tools like Yoast or RankMath. However, we strongly recommend disabling the specific schema-generation features of your other SEO plugins to avoid duplicating ld+json blocks on your pages.

Does SchemaForge support WooCommerce?

Yes! The Free version supports basic Product schema. The Pro version unlocks deep WooCommerce integration, including variable products, aggregate star ratings, and precise stock availability.

Is it a subscription?

No. The core plugin is 100% free. If you need advanced schemas, SchemaForge Pro is a one-time payment of $29 for a lifetime license. No recurring fees.
